title: New 2025 Insights Report: The State of Conversation Intelligence
summary: We’ve surveyed industry-leading founders, product leaders, and engineers to uncover how they think about, leverage, and build for conversation intelligence today.
body_markdown:
Conversation intelligence is no longer a trend—it's a transformative force reshaping how companies interact with customers.


Our brand-new[2025 State of Conversation Intelligence Report](https://www.assemblyai.com/2025-research-report) reveals just how rapidly this technology is evolving, spreading across teams, industries, and use cases. We surveyed product leaders, engineers, and executives—and the results are in: conversation intelligence is not just an add-on. It’s foundational.


[Click here to access the report now:](https://www.assemblyai.com/2025-research-report)


**Key questions answered in this report:**


- What’s driving adoption?
- Where is conversation intelligence heading in 2025 and beyond?
- What are the currency challenges of building and implementing conversation intelligence?


‍ **Conversation intelligence has crossed the threshold** from experimental to essential. In 2025 and beyond, winning teams will see voice data not just as raw input—but as the foundation for smarter, faster, more customer-centric operations.


Explore the full[State of Conversation Intelligence Insights Report](https://www.assemblyai.com/2025-research-report) to learn how forward-thinking leaders are building their conversation intelligence roadmaps today and the steps they’re taking to secure a successful future.
